card.name: The word change in mean-change results
card.fires_on: The word "change" right after "mean" (or "mean percent") when a label reports average shifts in weight, glucose, cholesterol or similar measures from baseline. Weaker on "from" or "was" in the same phrases.

modes.label: Mean change
modes.description: The word change after mean, introducing an average shift in a lab or weight measure.
modes.example: had a mean<< change>> in glucose of +1.2 mg

modes.label: Change from baseline
modes.description: The word from or was in table or sentence wording about change from baseline.
modes.example: LDL n=198 n=117 n=130 Change<< from>> baseline -2.7 -2.

card.writes: It seems to push toward a signed number next, with plus or minus values, and away from words about negatives.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a label says the average change in a measure, just before the number is given.
